title: Expression profile of urinary exosomal miRNAs in patients with diabetic kidney disease and their associated with kidney damage
description: Diabetic kidney disease (DKD) is the primary cause of end-stage renal disease. The aim of study is to seek noninvasive biomarkers for DKD at early stage or a target for the treatment of DKD through analysis of the urinary exosomal miRNAs expression profiles in DKD patients.
